title: Deep Discriminative Feature Fusion of Convolutional and Attention-Based Recurrent Representations for Subject-Independent ECG Stress Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.29870v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stress has become a significant concern because of its negative impact on both physical and mental health and therefore drives the need for reliable automated systems to assess stress levels. Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals provide a non-invasive and objective measure of physiological stress responses and have emerged as a promising modality for continuous stress monitoring. While deep learning techniques have achieved encouraging results in ECG-based stress detection, many studies focus only on one type of feature representation, and therefore limit their ability to capture both the morphological patterns and temporal dynamics embedded in ECG signals. To address this limitation, in this paper, we propose three deep learning-based feature fusion frameworks for ECG-based stress classification. translated_abstract: 压力因其对身体和心理健康的负面影响已成为一个重大问题，因此催生了对可靠的压力水平自动化评估系统的需求。心电图（ECG）信号提供了一种无创且客观的生理应激反应测量方式，已成为持续压力监测的一种有前景的模态。尽管深度学习技术在基于ECG的压力检测中已取得令人鼓舞的成果，但许多研究仅关注单一类型的特征表示，因而限制了其同时捕获ECG信号中蕴含的形态模式与时间动态的能力。为解决这一局限，本文提出了三种基于深度学习的特征融合框架，用于基于ECG的压力分类，分别是残差特征融合（RFF）、双向特征级交叉注意力融合（BFCAF），以及一种新颖的交叉注意力残差融合（CA（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出残差特征融合、双向特征级交叉注意力融合和交叉注意力残差融合三种深度特征融合框架，将卷积与注意力循环表征相结合，以实现受试者无关的心电压力识别。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes three deep feature fusion frameworks—Residual Feature Fusion, Bidirectional Feature-Wise Cross-Attention Fusion, and a novel Cross-Attention Residual Fusion—that combine convolutional and attention-based recurrent representations to achieve subject-independent ECG stress recognition.
